ImageDescription.value: Csokonai Theatre building. There are six, limestone, facade, niche building ornament statues: Sándor Petőfi by Iván Szabó, Mihály Vörösmarty by István Kamotsay, Ferenc Kazinczy by Lajos Ungvári, Mihály Csokonai Vitéz by Sándor Várady, Ferenc Kölcsey by Mihály Dabóczi, Károly Kisfaludy by Károly Stöckert. On the top are two goddess architectural statues: Melpomene by József Antal and Terpsichore by Sándor Boldogfai Farkas. The eight architectural statues were János Marschalkó works, but they were in such bad condition that in 1961 they were replaced with the statues we see today. Limestone CoA facade relief made by László Halász (1865 works reconstruction). Before the theater are two busts, one is Árpád Horváth Theatre Director by Nándor Berky, the other is Árpád Téri by Richárd Török (1990 bronze) - 10 Kossuth Street, Liszt Ferenc Square, Inner City, Debrecen, Hajdú-Bihar County, Hungary
